overview.en: The National Council (Nationalrat) of 183 members is elected by proportional representation for five years; the Federal Council (Bundesrat) is elected by the Land parliaments and can delay legislation with a reasoned objection. The directly elected Federal President appoints the Federal Chancellor and Government without an investiture vote; the National Council can remove them by an express vote of no confidence.
overview.zh: 国民议会（Nationalrat）183 名议员以比例代表制选出，任期五年；联邦议会（Bundesrat）由各州议会选举产生，可通过附理由的异议延缓立法。直选联邦总统任命联邦总理和政府，无需授职投票；国民议会可通过明确的不信任决议将其免职。

note.en: RIS consolidated federal law, version of 16 November 2026; each article carries its own valid-from date.
note.zh: RIS 联邦法律合并文本，2026 年 11 月 16 日版本；各条款分别标注生效日期。

basis.en: set by the National Council Electoral Act 1992
basis.zh: 由《1992 年国民议会选举法》规定

label.en: Equal, direct, personal, free and secret suffrage of citizens aged 16 or over, on the principles of proportional representation
label.zh: 年满 16 岁公民平等、直接、亲自、自由、秘密投票，依比例代表原则

powers.en: Adopts federal laws (subject to the Bundesrat's objection, Art. 42) and can withdraw confidence from the Government or any minister (Art. 74).
powers.zh: 通过联邦法律（受联邦议会异议权约束，第 42 条），并可撤回对政府或任何部长的信任（第 74 条）。

note.en: The legislative period is five years (Art. 27, wording valid from 28 October 2008); the National Council may dissolve itself by simple law (Art. 29(2)).
note.zh: 立法期为五年（第 27 条，2008 年 10 月 28 日起生效的措辞）；国民议会可通过普通法律自行解散（第 29 条第 2 款）。

basis.en: the most populous Land sends 12 members, the others in proportion to their citizens, each at least 3; numbers fixed by the Federal President after each census
basis.zh: 人口最多的州派 12 名，其他州按公民人数比例派出，每州至少 3 名；各州人数由联邦总统在每次人口普查后确定

label.en: Elected by each Land parliament for its own legislative period, by proportional representation; the second-strongest party receives at least one seat
label.zh: 由各州议会按比例代表原则选举，任期与该州议会立法期一致；第二大党至少获得一席

powers.en: May raise a reasoned objection to a National Council law within eight weeks; the National Council overrides it by repeating its decision with at least half of its members present (Art. 42).
powers.zh: 可在八周内对国民议会通过的法律提出附理由的异议；国民议会在至少半数议员出席时重申原决议即可推翻（第 42 条）。

note.en: Members need not belong to the Land parliament that elects them but must be eligible for it (Art. 35(2)). The current total was not verified.
note.zh: 成员不必是选举其的州议会议员，但须具备该州议会被选举资格（第 35 条第 2 款）。当前总人数未核实。

label.en: Elected by the federal people by equal, direct, personal, free and secret ballot; more than half of all valid votes
label.zh: 由联邦人民以平等、直接、亲自、自由、秘密方式选举；须获全部有效票过半数

term_limit.en: Re-election for the immediately following term only once; removable before the end of term by referendum on the Federal Assembly's demand
term_limit.zh: 仅可连任一次；可应联邦大会要求经全民公投提前罢免

label.en: Appointed by the Federal President; other ministers on the Chancellor's proposal. No investiture vote; dismissal of the Chancellor or whole Government needs no proposal
label.zh: 由联邦总统任命，其他部长依总理提议任命。无授职投票；免去总理或整个政府无需提议

label.en: Democratic republic
label.zh: 民主共和国

label.en: Federal state of nine Länder
label.zh: 由九个州组成的联邦制国家

label.en: Federal parliamentary republic
label.zh: 联邦议会共和制

detail.en: The Government needs the National Council's tolerance (Art. 74) but is appointed, and may be dismissed, by a directly elected Federal President (Arts. 60, 70). Comparative literature sometimes classifies this as semi-presidential.
detail.zh: 政府须获国民议会容忍（第 74 条），但由直选联邦总统任命并可被其免职（第 60、70 条）。比较政治学文献有时将其归为半总统制。

label.en: National Council (elected) and Federal Council (elected by Land parliaments)
label.zh: 国民议会（直选）与联邦议会（由州议会选举）

detail.en: The Federal Council's objection is suspensive: the National Council can override it with a simple repeat decision.
detail.zh: 联邦议会的异议为搁置性：国民议会以简单的重申决议即可推翻。

label.en: Direct popular vote; absolute majority of valid votes
label.zh: 选民直选；须获有效票绝对多数

label.en: 6 years; one immediate re-election
label.zh: 六年；可连任一次

label.en: Federal President appoints the Chancellor and, on the Chancellor's proposal, the ministers
label.zh: 联邦总统任命总理，并依总理提议任命部长

detail.en: The cited articles provide no investiture vote. If a Government is appointed while the National Council is not sitting, the President convenes it so the new Government can be presented (Art. 70(3)); the Government remains subject to Art. 74.
detail.zh: 所引条款未规定授职投票。若政府在国民议会休会期间任命，总统须召集国民议会以便介绍新政府（第 70 条第 3 款）；政府始终受第 74 条约束。

steps.en: Federal President appoints the Federal Chancellor
steps.zh: 联邦总统任命联邦总理

steps.en: Ministers appointed on the Chancellor's proposal

label.en: No investiture vote
label.zh: 无授职投票

label.en: Express resolution of the National Council with half of members present
label.zh: 国民议会在半数议员出席时作出明确决议

detail.en: Applies to the Government or individual ministers, who must then be removed from office; the vote can be postponed to the second working day on a minority request.
detail.zh: 适用于整个政府或个别部长，其后必须免职；经一定数量议员要求，表决可推迟至第二个工作日。

label.en: No separate confidence-vote procedure in the cited articles
label.zh: 所引条款未规定单独的信任投票程序

label.en: Federal President may dissolve the National Council once for the same reason; the Council may dissolve itself by law
label.zh: 联邦总统可解散国民议会，但同一理由仅限一次；国民议会可通过法律自行解散

detail.en: After a presidential dissolution the new Council must be able to meet within 100 days.
detail.zh: 总统解散后，新国民议会须能在 100 日内召开。

label.en: Federal Council suspensive objection within eight weeks; National Council repeat decision overrides
label.zh: 联邦议会八周内可提出搁置性异议；国民议会重申决议即可推翻

label.en: Federal Council: reasoned suspensive objection
label.zh: 联邦议会：附理由的搁置性异议

label.en: Constitutional Court (Verfassungsgerichtshof)
label.zh: 宪法法院（Verfassungsgerichtshof）

label.en: 5 years (National Council)
label.zh: 五年（国民议会）

label.en: List PR in three procedures (regional, Land, federal); 4% nationally or one regional seat
label.zh: 分地区、州、联邦三级程序的名单比例代表制；须全国 4% 或赢得一个地区议席

summary.en: List proportional representation allocated in three procedures
summary.zh: 分三级程序分配的名单比例代表制

constituencies.en: Constituencies that do not cross Land borders, each subdivided into regional constituencies (B-VG Art. 26(2)), plus a federal tier (NRWO § 107)
constituencies.zh: 不跨越州界的选区，各再划分为地区选区（B-VG 第 26 条第 2 款），另设联邦层级（NRWO 第 107 条）

allocation.en: First procedure in regional constituencies, second in Land constituencies by the electoral quota (§ 101), third at federal level for all 183 seats less those already allocated (§ 107)
allocation.zh: 第一级在地区选区、第二级在州选区按选举配额分配（第 101 条），第三级在联邦层面分配 183 席中尚未分配的议席（第 107 条）

title.en: Five-year legislative period of the National Council

new.en: The National Council's legislative period lasts five years from its first meeting (Art. 27(1)).
new.zh: 国民议会立法期自首次会议起为五年（第 27 条第 1 款）。

changes.legal_basis: B-VG Art. 27, RIS valid-from date 28 October 2008

note.en: The previous wording and the amending act were not read.
note.zh: 此前措辞和修正法未阅读。

reason.en: The current number of Federal Council members fixed after the last census was not read.
reason.zh: 最近一次人口普查后确定的联邦议会现任人数未读取。

reason.en: Earlier versions of B-VG articles (for example the four-year term before 2008) were not read.
reason.zh: B-VG 各条款的早期版本（如 2008 年前的四年任期）未阅读。
